_metadata.notes: All channels verified as real and active as of Feb 2026. Usernames are case-sensitive in Telethon. Categories align with Brain 2 catalyst_type taxonomy.

channels.notes: 332K subs. Official Whale Alert — large BTC/ETH/USDT transfers. Extremely high volume, structured format easy to parse.
Official @CryptoWhaleBot channel. BTC transfers with sender/receiver balances. Sister channels: @WhaleBotRektd (liquidations), @WhaleBotPumps (alt monitor).
Liquidation alerts from WhaleBot ecosystem. Useful for cascade/sentiment detection.
Alt coin pump detection from WhaleBot. Directly relevant to ignition model.
Smart money on-chain tracking. Whale wallet movements, exchange flows. Very high signal for pre-ignition detection.
Official Binance announcements. New listings, delistings, trading pair changes. Critical for listing_rumor catalyst detection.
Official Bybit announcements channel.
Official OKX announcements. Listings, delistings, network upgrades.
Official KuCoin announcement channel. Active with listings, alpha zone additions.
Official Crypto.com announcements.
Bybit API changes — useful for detecting new trading pair availability before public announcement.
500K+ subs. Major crypto news outlet. Multiple posts/day. Market news sub-channel: @CTMarkets.
CoinTelegraph markets sub-channel. Price-focused news and analysis.
11K subs. CoinGecko official news channel.
Pioneering on-chain analytics. 1-2 posts/day with BTC metrics, SOPR, HODL waves, exchange flows.
ZachXBT's channel. Scam/hack/exploit investigations. High signal for negative catalyst detection (hacks, rug pulls).
Rekt News — DeFi exploits, hacks, and post-mortems.
Rekt News alerts channel.
Coin Bureau Insider. Market analysis and insights from a well-known crypto analyst team.
Crypto Narratives channel. Tracks emerging narrative themes — directly maps to Brain 2 narrative_category.
Curated daily alpha, DeFi insights, emerging trends.
ICO Analytics. Token sale calendars, independent ratings, market dashboards.
100 Eyes Crypto Scanner. Technical analysis alerts and chart pattern detection.
LunarCrush announcements. Social media engagement metrics for crypto — meta-signal for our own pipeline.
Bybit Crypto Feed — broader crypto news curated by Bybit.
